Source-authenticated request traces reach ordinary width (f-1)G; the tiny supplied-child transport fixture costs 5604 payload primitives at dirty ancestor extents 16,257,4096. test_authoring_rationale.contract: The actual PR2250 monomial caller must batch all columns into equal (f-1)G ordinary fields; the tiny caller trace must retain complete rows, borrowed inputs, return descriptors and dirty parked ancestors with local-only movement.
test_authoring_rationale.credible_regressions: Wrong n=f, unsplit root reservoir, omitted spectator/descriptor, historical rewind, full-backing erasure, uncleared local stack.
test_authoring_rationale.existing_coverage: PR2250 tests its local adapter endpoint; task08 treats child volume. Neither validates installation of this recursive complex stack boundary or proves its cost from geometric space. This package does not repeat their endpoint or full-fill checks.
test_authoring_rationale.production_seams: No predecessor edits or test-only production exports. Authenticated existing modules are loaded from source; only payload execution is explicitly recorded for request-shape inspection, never presented as endpoint proof.
